item.tib: bla sgrub kyi cha lag bshad sgrub bstan pa'i dga' ston g.yang 'bod
item.coloph: de ltar dad mos rtse gcig gi dag snang blo yis rab bskul nas/ bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas phyir du/ snang btsun nam blo ming gis bris/ nyes tshogs bshags la dge 'bras kyis/ gyer bstan dar rgyas yun gnas shog tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
